title: Parametric lathed vase (Babylon.js (Node.js, headless NullEngine))
seed: Build a script from scratch in Babylon.js (Node.js, headless NullEngine) that procedurally generates: Generate a vase by revolving a 2D profile curve (radius as a function of height -- narrower at the neck, wider at the belly) 360 degrees around the vertical axis. Profile control points (or function), height, and radial segment count must be CLI-configurable. Save to glb with deterministic seeding, CLI parameterization, and an independent post-save validation step.
